predictions: No allele-specific TF occupancy at rs7001688 in Hep 3B2.1-7.
No allele-specific enhancer activity for rs7001688.
Any LDL association is due to a linked causal variant, not rs7001688 itself.

chains.title: HNF4A-dependent liver enhancer at CYP7A1

links.claim: HNF4A binds the ref G allele more strongly than alt T at rs7001688. HNF4A is selected as a liver-enriched TF relevant to CYP7A1 regulation; no QBiC-SELEX model or occupancy evidence is supplied in this no-evidence case, so this is a motif/literature-based hypothesis only.
The variant sits in a hepatocyte regulatory element; the ref G allele increases HNF4A-dependent enhancer activity.
The element regulates CYP7A1, the nearby cholesterol/bile-acid gene; the ref G allele increases CYP7A1 expression.
This occurs in Hep 3B2.1-7 hepatocyte-like cells, where HNF4A and CYP7A1 are expressed.
Increased CYP7A1 lowers hepatic cholesterol and plasma LDL cholesterol; thus the ref G allele is predicted to associate with lower LDL.

predictions: Allele-specific HNF4A occupancy at rs7001688 in Hep 3B2.1-7: ref G > alt T.
Reporter assay in Hep 3B2.1-7: ref G allele has higher enhancer activity than alt T.
CYP7A1 expression is higher with the ref G allele in hepatocyte context.
falsified_if: No allele-specific HNF4A binding at rs7001688 in hepatocyte nuclear extract or ChIP.
The variant does not alter enhancer activity in Hep 3B2.1-7.
CYP7A1 expression is not allele-dependently regulated in hepatocytes.

chains.title: SREBF2 sterol-response element mechanism

links.claim: SREBF2 binds the alt T allele more strongly than ref G at rs7001688. SREBF2 is chosen as the cholesterol-axis TF; no QBiC-SELEX model or occupancy evidence is supplied, so this is speculative.
The variant lies in a sterol-responsive regulatory element; the alt T allele increases SREBF2-dependent element activity.
The element modulates CYP7A1 expression; alt T increases SREBF2-mediated repression of CYP7A1.
This occurs in Hep 3B2.1-7 hepatocytes with active SREBF2 cholesterol regulation.
Reduced CYP7A1 raises hepatic cholesterol and plasma LDL cholesterol; thus alt T is predicted to associate with higher LDL.

predictions: Allele-specific SREBF2 occupancy at rs7001688 in Hep 3B2.1-7: alt T > ref G.
Sterol-responsive reporter activity is higher for alt T than ref G.
CYP7A1 expression is lower with alt T under sterol-replete conditions.
falsified_if: No allele-specific SREBF2 binding at rs7001688.
The element does not respond to sterol/SREBF2 perturbation.
CYP7A1 expression is not altered by SREBF2 knockdown in hepatocytes.

chains.title: CEBPB liver enhancer mechanism

links.claim: CEBPB binds the alt T allele more strongly than ref G at rs7001688. CEBPB is chosen as a liver-expressed enhancer TF; no QBiC-SELEX model or occupancy evidence is supplied, so this is speculative.
The variant lies in a CEBPB-responsive hepatocyte enhancer; alt T increases enhancer activity.
The enhancer increases CYP7A1 expression; alt T is predicted to increase CYP7A1 transcription.
This occurs in Hep 3B2.1-7 hepatocytes, which support CEBPB-dependent enhancer activity.
Increased CYP7A1 lowers plasma LDL cholesterol; thus alt T is predicted to associate with lower LDL.

predictions: Allele-specific CEBPB occupancy at rs7001688 in Hep 3B2.1-7: alt T > ref G.
Reporter activity is higher for alt T than ref G in hepatocytes.
CYP7A1 expression is higher with alt T.
falsified_if: No allele-specific CEBPB binding at rs7001688.
CEBPB knockdown does not alter the element's activity.

no or weak allele difference for HNF4A

next_experiment: The top two hypotheses are C4 (probability 0.45) and C1 (probability 0.30). The single cheapest experiment to separate them is an allele-specific HNF4A EMSA or HNF4A ChIP-qPCR at rs7001688 in Hep 3B2.1-7 cells. If HNF4A shows ref G > alt T allele-specific occupancy, C1 is supported; if there is no allele-specific HNF4A binding, C4 remains favored.
